vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: api-device-live
Version: 1.0.2

The skill is a legitimate tool for retrieving live stream URLs for Closeli smart devices. The Python script (get_live_url.py) correctly implements credential management via environment variables and a local configuration file (~/.openclaw/.env), and communicates only with the specified API gateway (defaulting to ai-open-gateway.closeli.cn). The instructions in SKILL.md are focused on formatting the output for the user and include appropriate security warnings regarding TLS verification and credential handling.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required environment variables are consistent with its stated purpose of fetching a device H5 live URL; nothing requested or installed is disproportionate, but follow the provided precautions about shared credential files and API key scope.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (fetching a device live H5 URL) aligns with requirements: python3 runtime and a single API credential AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY. Declared optional host and TLS flags match network behavior in the code.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to run the bundled script, parse its JSON output, and format the result for display — this matches the script behavior. Note: the script will read ~/.openclaw/.env as a fallback unless AI_GATEWAY_NO_ENV_FILE=true; the skill correctly documents this and warns about the shared-file risk. The script also prints HTTP error bodies to stderr (resp.text), which could reveal service error contents — minor disclosure risk but contextually related to the task.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or external downloads; the skill is instruction+script only. It depends on the httpx Python package, which is documented and not pulled automatically by the skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY is required as a primary credential, which is appropriate. The fallback to a shared file (~/.openclaw/.env) is documented but increases the risk that other skills or files could access the same secret; the skill itself advises disabling this fallback in production (AI_GATEWAY_NO_ENV_FILE=true) and using minimal-permission API keys.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills or system-wide configs, and contains no installation hooks. It runs as a one-shot script and makes only the documented API calls.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: call your Closeli AI gateway to get an H5 live URL. Before installing: 1) Provide an API key with the minimum scope needed (only live-link read access). 2) Avoid storing the key in the shared ~/.openclaw/.env in production — set AI_GATEWAY_NO_ENV_FILE=true and pass the key via environment variable. 3) Verify AI_GATEWAY_HOST is correct and trustworthy; do not disable TLS verification in production. 4) Be aware that HTTP error responses are printed and could include service-provided text; do not expose CLI output or logs to untrusted parties. 5) Ensure python3 and the httpx package are available.
